meals.name: Baked Broccoli Mac with Crispy Golden Crumb

meals.name: Smoky Bacon and Pea Mac with Potato-Carrot Sauce
meals.description: A hearty hob-top mac with a surprisingly creamy sauce made from blended potato and carrot, finished with smoky bacon and sweet peas. Cosy, filling and ready in about half an hour.

meals.name: Butternut and Cashew Creamy Mac 'Cheese'
meals.description: Silky, golden sauce made from roasted-soft butternut squash and cashews, boosted with nutritional yeast for a cheesy tang. Pure comfort in a bowl, and completely dairy-free.

meals.name: Baked Mac and Cheese with Crispy Crumb Topping
meals.description: Classic oven-baked macaroni in a creamy oat milk white sauce with melting dairy-free cheese, tucked-in broccoli and a crunchy golden breadcrumb crust.

meals.name: One-Pot Smoky Bacon Mac with Peas
meals.description: A hearty one-pot supper where potato and carrot blend into a velvety, cheesy-tasting sauce, tossed through macaroni with smoky bacon and sweet peas.

meals.name: Ultimate Cheesy Beef Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: Layers of rich, hidden-veg beef ragù, silky cheese sauce made with cornflour and gluten-free lasagne sheets, all topped with a bubbling golden mozzarella and Cheddar crust.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Broccoli Cheesy Lasagne
meals.description: A white lasagne with tender chicken, soft broccoli and a creamy Cheddar and cream cheese sauce between layers of gluten-free pasta. Mild, comforting and very cheesy.

meals.name: One-Pan Lasagne Pasta Bake with Ricotta
meals.description: All the flavours of lasagne without the layering: gluten-free pasta simmered in a tomato and turkey sauce, dotted with creamy ricotta and finished under a golden mozzarella blanket.

meals.name: Classic Cheesy Beef Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: Rich beef and hidden-veg ragu layered with gluten-free pasta sheets and a creamy cornflour cheese sauce, finished with a golden bubbling mozzarella and Cheddar top.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Spinach White Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: A mild, creamy lasagne with tender chicken, sweetcorn and wilted spinach in a silky cheese sauce, layered with gluten-free pasta and baked until golden.

meals.name: Cheesy Taco-Style Tortilla Lasagne
meals.description: A fun, naturally gluten-free twist: layers of corn tortillas, mildly spiced turkey and bean filling and plenty of melted Cheddar, with a spoonful of soured cream on top.

meals.name: Classic Cheesy Beef Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: Rich beef and tomato ragù layered with gluten-free lasagne sheets and a creamy cheese sauce, finished with a bubbling golden cheddar and mozzarella top.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken, Mushroom and Spinach White Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: A mild, silky white lasagne with tender chicken, sweet mushrooms and soft spinach, all under a blanket of melted cheese. Gentle flavours that suit little ones.

meals.name: Cheesy Sweet Potato and Lentil Lasagne
meals.description: A naturally gluten-free veggie lasagne with sweet potato slices in place of pasta, layered with a hidden-veg lentil tomato sauce, creamy ricotta and stretchy mozzarella.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry with Sunflower Seed Sauce
meals.description: Tender strips of chicken and crunchy vegetables tossed with egg noodles in a creamy, nut-free satay-style sauce made with sunflower seed butter, coconut milk and a squeeze of lime. Mild and family-friendly.

meals.name: Prawn and Rice Noodle Stir-Fry with Creamy Tahini Satay Sauce
meals.description: Juicy prawns, courgette and pak choi stir-fried with silky rice noodles in a rich, nut-free satay sauce built on tahini, coconut milk and a touch of mild red curry paste.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Broccoli Satay Udon
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu, broccoli, mushrooms and carrot tossed with thick, chewy udon noodles in a glossy, nut-free satay sauce. A hearty vegetarian dinner the whole family will enjoy.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry with Nut-Free Sunflower Sauce
meals.description: Tender chicken, crunchy vegetables and rice noodles tossed in a silky, creamy satay-style sauce made with sunflower seed butter and coconut milk. It is rich and mild, and completely nut and peanut free.

meals.name: Prawn and Pak Choi Satay Udon
meals.description: Juicy prawns and thick, chewy udon noodles coated in a creamy, gently spiced satay sauce with a hint of lime. Sunflower seed butter gives the sauce its richness without any nuts.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Vegetable Satay Egg Noodles
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu, broccoli, courgette and beansprouts with springy egg noodles in a rich, creamy satay-style sauce. A hearty vegetarian dinner that is gently flavoured and nut free.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken, crunchy vegetables and silky rice noodles tossed in a creamy, mildly spiced satay sauce made with sunflower seed butter and coconut milk, so it is completely nut-free.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Broccoli Satay Udon
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu and tender broccoli with chewy udon noodles, coated in a rich, creamy sunflower seed satay sauce with a gentle sweetness that kids love.

meals.name: Beef and Green Bean Satay Egg Noodles
meals.description: Quickly seared strips of beef and crisp green beans with egg noodles in a smooth, savoury-sweet satay sauce, mild enough for the whole family.

meals.name: Salmon Poke Bowl with Sesame-Free Ginger Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of sushi-grade salmon on seasoned rice with creamy avocado, crisp cucumber and edamame, finished with a zesty ginger-soy dressing and toasted sunflower seeds for a nutty crunch.

meals.name: Seared Salmon Rice Bowl with Honey-Ginger Glaze
meals.description: Crisp-skinned salmon glazed with honey, ginger and soy, served over fluffy rice with garlicky pak choi and a squeeze of lime.

meals.name: Cold Salmon Noodle Poke Salad with Peanut-Ginger Dressing
meals.description: Flaked baked salmon tossed with chilled rice noodles, crunchy red cabbage, carrot and cucumber in a nutty peanut-ginger dressing, topped with fresh coriander and crushed peanuts.

meals.name: Salmon Poke Bowl with Sesame-Free Ginger Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of fresh salmon on sushi rice with creamy avocado, crisp cucumber and edamame, all tied together with a zingy soy-ginger dressing. Toasted sunflower seeds give the nutty crunch usually provided by sesame.

meals.name: Seared Salmon Ginger-Soy Rice Bowl
meals.description: Pan-seared salmon glazed with honey, soy and ginger, served warm over fluffy rice with tender broccoli and carrot ribbons. A cosy, cooked take on the poke bowl.

meals.name: Cold Poke-Style Smoked Salmon Noodle Bowl
meals.description: Chilled rice noodles tossed with a lime, soy and ginger dressing, topped with flaky hot-smoked salmon, crunchy cucumber, carrot and red cabbage. Light, fresh and ready in 20 minutes.

meals.name: Salmon Poke Bowl with Sesame-Free Ginger Soy Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of raw salmon on sushi rice with cucumber, avocado, edamame and carrot, dressed with a zingy ginger-soy dressing. Toasted sunflower seeds add the nutty crunch, so it is completely sesame-free. Use sushi-grade salmon.

meals.name: Seared Ginger-Soy Salmon Rice Bowl with Broccoli
meals.description: Pan-seared salmon glazed in a sticky ginger, garlic and honey soy sauce, served over fluffy rice with tender broccoli and crisp carrot. A warm, family-friendly take on a poke bowl.

meals.name: Smoked Salmon and Mango Quinoa Poke Bowl
meals.description: A quick, no-cook-protein bowl of flaked smoked salmon, juicy mango, crunchy red cabbage and cucumber over quinoa, finished with a bright lime and ginger dressing and toasted pumpkin seeds.

meals.name: Cod and Pea Summer Paella
meals.description: A classic saffron-scented paella with flaky cod, sweet red peppers and peas, finished with a squeeze of lemon and fresh parsley. Smoked paprika gives it a warm, smoky depth without any chorizo.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon and Green Bean Paella
meals.description: A hands-off paella baked in the oven, with tender salmon, green beans and burst cherry tomatoes. The rice turns golden and fragrant with turmeric and smoked paprika.

meals.name: Smoky Haddock, Courgette and Sweetcorn Paella
meals.description: A relaxed, smoky take on paella using smoked haddock, courgette and sweetcorn. Saffron and spring onions make it light and summery, ideal for a lazy weekend lunch in the garden.

meals.name: Hake and Pea Summer Paella
meals.description: A classic hob-top paella with golden saffron rice, flaky hake, sweet peas and roasted red pepper, finished with a squeeze of lemon. It has all the flavour of a seafood paella without any shellfish.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon and Courgette Paella
meals.description: A relaxed, mostly hands-off paella. Saffron rice bakes with courgette and cherry tomatoes, topped with succulent chunks of salmon. It is ideal for a lazy summer weekend.

meals.name: Chicken and Cod Mixed Paella
meals.description: A hearty surf-and-turf paella with tender chicken thigh and flaky cod, green beans and sweet red pepper. The rice is fragrant with saffron, smoked paprika and thyme.

meals.name: Hake and Pea Summer Paella
meals.description: A classic hob-cooked paella with saffron-scented rice, sweet red pepper and flaky hake, finished with peas, lemon and parsley. Smoked paprika gives the smoky depth you'd usually get from chorizo.

meals.name: Salmon and Smoked Haddock Paella with Green Beans
meals.description: A golden turmeric-tinted paella studded with chunks of salmon and smoky haddock, crisp green beans and a tomato base. Finish with a squeeze of lemon for a fresh summer feel.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Cod, Courgette and Cherry Tomato Paella
meals.description: An easy hands-off paella baked in the oven with juicy cherry tomatoes, tender courgette and chunks of cod. The rice soaks up saffron and paprika-spiced stock for a relaxed weekend meal.

meals.name: Vegan Mushroom Carbonara with Smoky Tofu Bacon
meals.description: Silky spaghetti coated in a creamy cashew and nutritional yeast sauce, topped with crisp smoky tofu 'bacon' and golden mushrooms for a proper date night carbonara.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Crunchy Breadcrumbs
meals.description: Comforting macaroni in a velvety, cheesy sauce made from potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, finished with a golden garlicky breadcrumb crunch.

meals.name: Creamy Garlic Spinach and Sun-Dried Tomato Penne
meals.description: Penne tossed in a luscious, cheesy cashew-free sauce of silken tofu and nutritional yeast, with wilted spinach and sweet sun-dried tomatoes for a restaurant-style finish.

meals.name: Vegan Mushroom Carbonara
meals.description: Silky spaghetti coated in a creamy cashew and nutritional yeast sauce, finished with smoky crispy mushrooms standing in for bacon and plenty of black pepper.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Garlic Breadcrumbs
meals.description: Comforting macaroni in a velvety, cheesy sauce made from potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, topped with golden crunchy garlic breadcrumbs.

meals.name: Creamy Lemon and Spinach Tagliatelle
meals.description: Ribbons of tagliatelle in a rich, silky sauce of vegan cream cheese, nutritional yeast and lemon, with wilted spinach and peas for a fresh, elegant finish.

meals.name: Vegan Mushroom Carbonara with Smoky Tofu Bacon
meals.description: Silky cashew and nutritional yeast sauce clings to spaghetti, topped with crisp smoky tofu 'bacon' and plenty of black pepper. Rich, glossy and indulgent.

meals.name: Creamy Garlic and Spinach Baked Penne with Melty Vegan Cheese
meals.description: Penne in a luscious oat cream and garlic sauce, topped with melty vegan mozzarella and baked until bubbling and golden.

meals.name: Lemony Creamy Pea and Courgette Linguine
meals.description: Fresh, silky linguine in a blended white bean and vegan parmesan-style sauce, with sweet peas, ribbons of courgette and a squeeze of lemon. Rich but bright.

meals.description: Kleepuv sushiriis, mahlane teriyaki-kana, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk. Kõik koos noritükkide ja seesamiga.

meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee sidruni ja tilliga, kõrval kuldsed ahjukartulid ja õrnad sparglid. Kõik küpseb koos ühel plaadil.

meals.name: Spinati-ricotta lasanje
meals.description: Kreemjas spinati- ja ricottatäidis tomatikastme ja sulanud mozzarella vahel. Pealt kuldne ja kergelt krõbe.

meals.description: Õrn tursafilee küpseb kirsstomatite, suvikõrvitsa ja oliividega, serveeritud kohevale riisile. Aroomi annab pune ja küüslauk.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sidruni ja tilliga
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee sidruni, tilli ja või maitsega, kõrval kuldsed ahjukartulid ja õrnad sparglid. Kõik valmib ühes ahjuvormis, nii et laud saab kiiresti pidulikuks.

meals.name: Spinati-ricotta cannelloni
meals.description: Kreemjas spinati-ricotta täidis pastatorudes, kaetud tomatikastme ja sulanud mozzarellaga. Pealt kuldne ja kihisev.

meals.name: Ahjupaprikad riisi ja fetaga
meals.description: Magusad paprikad on täidetud riisi, fetajuustu ja tomatiga. Ahjus pehmeks küpsenud, pealt kergelt röstitud.

meals.name: Kanawokk nuudlitega
meals.description: Mahlane kanafilee, krõmpsuvad köögiviljad ja läikivad munanuudlid ingveri-küüslaugukastmes. Kõik valmib kuumal pannil paari minutiga.

meals.name: Maapähklikana riisinuudlitega
meals.description: Kreemjas maapähklikaste mähib kanatükke, brokolit ja õhukesi riisinuudleid. Koriander ja laim annavad värske lõpu.

meals.name: Karri-kookosnuudlid kanaga
meals.description: Kuldne karrine kookoskaste ümbritseb kanatükke, kapsast ja munanuudleid. Kõik küpseb ühel pannil kiiresti.

meals.name: Kanawokk munanuudlitega
meals.description: Õrnad kanatükid, krõmpsuv paprika ja brokoli ning läikivad munanuudlid. Kõik valmib kuumal pannil mõne minutiga.

meals.name: Kana pad thai
meals.description: Kleepuvad riisinuudlid kanatükkide, mune ja röstitud maapähklitega. Kaste on magushapu ja laimine.

meals.name: Karrine kananuudliwokk
meals.description: Kuldne karrikaste kookospiimaga ümbritseb õhukesi riisivermišelle, kana ja värvilisi köögivilju. Koriander lisab värskust.

meals.name: Kana-wokk munanuudlitega
meals.description: Kiirelt pannil kuldseks praetud kanatükid, krõmpsuvad köögiviljad ja libedad nuudlid mee-laimikastmes. Maitseb nagu Aasia restorani wokk.

meals.name: Magushapu ananassikana

meals.name: Maapähklikana nuudlitega
meals.description: Kreemjas maapähklikaste ümbritseb kanatükke, brokolit ja nuudleid. Peale puistatud röstitud pähklid annavad krõmpsu.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed soojad kartulikuubikud, suitsune praetud tofu ja kreemjas taimne hapukoor. Maitse on nagu vanaema köögis, aga täiesti taimne.

meals.name: Ahjukartul kašuhapukoorega
meals.description: Kuldsed ahjukartulid ja krõbedaks küpsenud suitsutofu sidruniselt kreemja kašuhapukoore all. Peale tuleb palju värsket murulauku.

meals.name: Kartulisalat suitsuporgandiga
meals.description: Soe kartulisalat suitsupaprikas küpsetatud porgandiribade, kapparite ja jogurtikastmega. Porgand annab suitsuse maitse, mis tuletab meelde suitsukala.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehme soe kartul, suitsune tofu ja kreemjas sojajogurtikaste, nagu vanaema salat, aga taimne. Värske till ja hapukurk annavad krõmpsu.

meals.name: Ahjukartulisalat kikerhernestega
meals.description: Kuldseks röstitud kartul ja suitsupaprikas kikerherned sojajogurtikastmes. Murulauk ja küüslauk teevad selle koduse.

meals.name: Kartulisalat seentega
meals.description: Soe kartul ja pannil kuldseks praetud šampinjonid kreemjas sinepikastmes. Suitsupaprika toob juurde suitsuse maitse.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed soojad kartulid, suitsune tofu ja kreemjas jogurtikaste, nagu vanaema tegi. Hapukurk ja till annavad värske vindi.

meals.name: Ahjukartul india pähkli kastmega
meals.description: Kuldsed ahjukartulikiilud ja krõbedad suitsutofu kuubikud kreemja india pähkli kastme all. Kaste on siidjas ja kergelt hapukas nagu hapukoor.

meals.name: Kartuli-kikerhernesalat
meals.description: Soe kartulisalat suitsupaprikas röstitud kikerhernestega ja jogurtikastmega. Kikerherned on krõbedad ja annavad suitsukala asemel soolase, suitsuse maitse.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Kreemjas tomatikaste punaste läätsede ja riivitud porgandiga, mis hautub pehmeks poole tunniga. Peal sulav juust ja kõrval pehmed spagetid.

meals.name: Läätsekotletid jogurtikastmega
meals.description: Kuldse koorikuga kotletid porgandi ja kaerahelvestega, mis on seest pehmed. Kõrval jahe kurgi-tilli jogurtikaste.

meals.name: Mahe läätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Siidiselt kookoskreemine karri punaste läätsede, porgandi ja maisiga, ilma terava maitseta. Serveeritakse kohevate riisiterade peal.

meals.name: Läätse-bolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Pehme punase läätse ja tomatikaste spagettidega, mis maitseb nagu klassikaline bolognese. Porgand sulab kastmesse ära, nii et lapsed seda ei märkagi.

meals.name: Läätsekotletid jogurtikastmega
meals.description: Kuldsed ja õrnalt krõbedad läätsekotletid, mis on seest pehmed. Kõrvale tulevad kurk ja jahe jogurtikaste.

meals.name: Läätse-maguskartulikarri riisiga
meals.description: Kreemjas kookospiimas hautatud punane lääts ja maguskartul, õrnalt vürtsitatud. Pehme ja kergelt magus, serveeritud kohevas riisiga.

meals.name: Läätse-tomatipasta
meals.description: Siidine tomatikaste punaste läätsedega, mis hautuvad pehmeks ja annavad kastmele paksuse. Serveeritud spagettidega ja riivitud juustuga.

meals.name: Läätse-köögiviljapannkoogid
meals.description: Kuldsed ja pehmed pannkoogid punastest läätsedest, porgandist ja suvikõrvitsast. Serveeritud jogurtikastmega, mida lapsed armastavad kastmiseks.

meals.name: Läätse-riisipann juustuga
meals.description: Pehme riis ja rohelised läätsed koos maisi, herneste ja sulanud juustuga. Kõik valmib ühes pannis, nii et maitsed sulavad kokku.
